positions.name: AsyncRememberContractFrame
positions.frame: what does the ratified async job contract commit to for remember's dispatch, receipt, and result-delivery behavior?
positions.why: Both expressions render the same ratified contract in the same terse, jargon-native technical maxim register (mint-1), present-tense/realis, decision-grade conviction: src-1 states the top-line guarantees (receipt in seconds, cursor-polled extraction, no blocking, no lost work) and src-2 restates the dispatch mechanism itself (dispatch, then poll-or-piggyback) as the 'key decision' underlying those guarantees — one directional read of a single settled design. Held in tension: src-1 is a direct declarative from Wynn Castellano while src-2 carries a footing case (animator/author Xena ExpertGH, principal null), suggesting it may be the submitter's own gloss of the decision rather than Wynn's verbatim words — the frame holds both as articulating the same contract regardless of who is speaking it.
